pdf.name: Printed name
pdf.letter.title: Request for financial assistance
pdf.letter.p1: I am writing to ask you to review this account for financial assistance under {hospital}'s financial assistance policy.
pdf.letter.p2_free: Based on my household size and income, I believe I may qualify for free care under that policy.
pdf.letter.p2_discount: Based on my household size and income, I believe I may qualify for a discount under that policy.
pdf.letter.p3_one: My household is 1 person, with a yearly income of {income} before taxes. That is about {pct}% of the federal poverty line. My income statement and a list of the documents I am attaching are on the next pages.
pdf.letter.p3_other: My household has {n} people and a yearly income of {income} before taxes. That is about {pct}% of the federal poverty line. My income statement and a list of the documents I am attaching are on the next pages.
pdf.letter.p4: If you need a separate application form, send it to me at the address below. I also ask that you pause collection on this account while you review my request.
pdf.income.title: Income statement
pdf.income.intro: These are the answers I gave. The hospital may ask for documents that show them.
pdf.income.pct: Percent of the federal poverty line
pdf.income.policy_title: The policy line this request relies on
pdf.income.attest: The household size and income above are true to the best of my knowledge.
pdf.check.title: Documents to attach
pdf.check.intro: Attach a copy of each one. Keep the originals.
pdf.check.income: Proof of income: recent pay stubs or your last tax return
pdf.check.address: Proof of address, such as a utility bill or a lease
pdf.check.other: Anything the hospital's application asks for
pdf.check.send: Fill in your name and address, sign the letter and the income statement, and mail or bring everything to the hospital's billing office. Keep a copy for yourself.
pdf.check.help: Dollar For is a nonprofit that helps patients apply for hospital financial assistance, at no cost: dollarfor.org
pdf.footer_help: Free help with this application: Dollar For, dollarfor.org
